intros t a l.
unfold P_all_init.
split.
- intros [Hinit Hall] i Hi Hlen.
  rewrite length_cons in Hlen.
  destruct (Z.eq_dec i 0) as [H0|H0].
  + subst i. rewrite nth_zero. exact Hinit.
  + assert (Hk : (0 <= i <= list.Length.length l)%Z) by lia.
    destruct (nth_cons i a l Hk) as [_ Hcase].
    rewrite (Hcase H0). apply Hall; lia.
- intros Hall.
  assert (Hle : (0 <= 0)%Z) by lia.
  assert (Hb : (0 < list.Length.length (Init.Datatypes.cons a l))%Z)
    by (rewrite length_cons; pose proof (length_pos l); lia).
  assert (Hhead : IsInit_S1_dllist a t).
  { pose proof (Hall 0%Z Hle Hb) as Hh.
    rewrite nth_zero in Hh. exact Hh. }
  split.
  + exact Hhead.
  + intros i Hi Hlen.
    assert (Hk : (0 <= i + 1 <= list.Length.length l)%Z) by lia.
    destruct (nth_cons (i + 1)%Z a l Hk) as [_ Hcase].
    assert (Hne : ~ ((i + 1)%Z = 0%Z)) by lia.
    assert (Hb1 : (0 <= (i + 1)%Z)%Z) by lia.
    assert (Hb2 : ((i + 1)%Z < list.Length.length (Init.Datatypes.cons a l))%Z)
      by (rewrite length_cons; lia).
    pose proof (Hall (i + 1)%Z Hb1 Hb2) as Hh.
    rewrite (Hcase Hne) in Hh.
    replace ((i + 1) - 1)%Z with i in Hh by lia.
    exact Hh.
